candidate.background_need: The proposal claims that training all adults across five fictional countries in advanced AI within two weeks will instantly eliminate unemployment and guarantee regional prosperity without any confirmed partners, staff, or budget.

objectives.description: To train all adults across the five specified countries in advanced AI skills within a two-week period.

target_groups: All adults across the five fictional European locations

preliminary_activities.description: To launch an intensive, unstaffed two-week AI training program for all target adults.

expected_results.description: All target adults will complete the advanced AI training and achieve guaranteed employment immediately following completion.

proposed_indicators.description: The number of trained individuals who secure employment within one week of course completion.
proposed_indicators.measurement_method: Counting verified job offers received by trainees in the first seven days post-training.
